_comment: Every advisory surface at once. The base fixture is a charger with nothing
to report, so the quiet case is the default and only this scenario shows
the bell, the dashboard strip and the Settings > Safety markers.
One row per path worth exercising: an unacked critical (ground_check), an
acked sticky one that must stay listed and keep its marker (vent_check), a
non-sticky critical that offers Dismiss rather than Mute (gfci_tripped), a
wear item that links to relay health (relay_life), and one recorded before
the clock synced (relay_thermal, first_seen 0 -> unknown, not 1970).
count is 4, not 5: it excludes the muted entry, which is the contract.
Timestamps are anchored on the status fixture's frozen 2026-05-21T22:00:30Z.
